subject: Television & Streaming
title: Walt Disney's Sunday Nights
description: A 60-second lesson on Walt Disney's Sunday Nights.

hook.text: In 1954, Walt Disney did something no film mogul had done—he made a deal with television.

buildup.text: Disney's weekly show mixed animation, nature films, and behind-the-scenes magic from his studio.

discovery.text: The show wasn't just entertainment. It was an ad for Disneyland, which Disney was secretly building.

twist.text: Disney used free TV to sell a theme park nobody had seen. He turned a broadcast into a marketing masterpiece.

climax.text: Disneyland opened in 1955 to massive crowds. The TV show had pre-sold the dream to millions of families.

punchline.text: Disney used television to build a kingdom.

quiz.question: What was the hidden purpose of Walt Disney's weekly TV show?
options: To promote and fund the construction of Disneyland
